name: Asha Placeholder

transcript.text: What problems or symptoms are you having right now?
For two weeks I feel very tired and I get breathless climbing the stairs. Last week I had fever two times, around 100.
Anything else since your last treatment?
The fever went with paracetamol. I also have small sores in my mouth since the last cycle.
Which medicines do you take now? Tell me the dose if you know.
Trastuzumab injection every three weeks in day care, pantoprazole 40 in the morning, and ashwagandha powder at night that my sister gave me.
Has anyone in your family had cancer?
My mother had breast cancer when she was around 60.
Do you have earlier reports, scans or discharge papers?
I uploaded my biopsy and the chemo papers. I also did a PET CT at City Imaging Centre in September, that report is at home.
Thank you. Please upload that report too, and I will share all this with your doctor.
